name: @fossil-lang/playground
description: The loop, clickable: write a .fossil program in a browser tab, type-check it as you type, run it, get a corpus, query the corpus — all client-side, no server, the source bytes never leaving the machine. Never published; the pnpm-workspace entry is for resolution, not for npm.
//scripts: `build` type-checks first, because a playground that compiles but cannot resolve @fossil-lang/wasm's pkg/ is a build that passes and an app that white-screens. The three workspace dependencies each need their own `build` run first (each shells out to cargo + wasm-bindgen); `pnpm --filter @fossil-lang/playground... build` in the workflow is what orders that.
//bench: `bench` writes the large demo corpus into public/bench/ (gitignored, ~56 MB, ~5 s) by calling apps/corpus/guards/fixture.mjs — the SAME generator the corpus guards use, not a copy. It is deliberately NOT part of `dev` or `build`: it needs the `duckdb` binary on PATH, and a playground that refuses to start because an optional demo asset is missing would be the worse app. The streaming panel says how to generate it when it is absent. `verify-stream` checks the tile arithmetic against real bytes over a real HTTP server with Range, and needs `bench` to have run. `verify-canvas` drives the SAME `BoundedSource` the canvas mounts, over the same corpus, through the `duckdb` binary instead of a GPU — it is the automatable half of that panel, because cosmos.gl draws from `requestAnimationFrame` and a browser fires none in a tab that is not visible, which a tab opened under automation is not.
//kanzo-tech: The version is exact, not a range: @kanzo-tech/ui is at 0.0.1-alpha and a prerelease is not a contract yet. The @codemirror/* set is here rather than there because they are all OPTIONAL peers of @kanzo-tech/ui — its CodeEditor externalises every one and resolves them from the consumer.
//kanzo-graph: @kanzo-tech/graph is the renderer, and the duckdb pin that used to keep it out is GONE: 0.1.0 names @duckdb/duckdb-wasm nowhere at all, because the Mosaic half moved to @kanzo-tech/mosaic and the coordinator stopped arriving through @kanzo-tech/ui/analytics. Its required peers are @cosmos.gl/graph, react and @kanzo-tech/ui; @kanzo-tech/mosaic is OPTIONAL and lives entirely on the ./duckdb subpath, which this app does not import — src/tiles.ts implements BoundedSource directly over the app's own DuckDB connection, so no coordinator is created and no crossfilter exists to join. pnpm warns that @kanzo-tech/ui 0.0.1-alpha does not satisfy the 0.1.0 peer, and the warning is correct and inert: the only thing the renderer takes from ui is `cn`, exported by both, and bumping ui is the editor's decision and not this panel's.
